# C02 — Faithful Definition

## #0

A faithful definition makes a positive account of what it names and includes the act by which that account is made. Its fidelity lies in the relation it performs: the determination discloses its source through a finite form, while remaining answerable to what that form cannot possess. The defining act belongs to the reality being defined. It cannot acquire an outside position merely by describing that reality more completely.

[A01 — Subject, God and Faithful Definition](../A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **grounds** this concept in the performed definition of God and Subject. C02 holds the reusable distinction that performance earns: **non-exhaustion can be exact**. The account can identify, discriminate and commit without making its own boundary the boundary of what gives it standing.

## #1

Definition must actually determine. It says what is being claimed, distinguishes it from alternatives and gives the distinction a field in which it can be understood. “Something beyond words” is under-defined when it leaves the reader unable to distinguish the proposed relation from any other. A faithful account takes the risk of saying something definite.

[C03 — Determination](C03-Determination.md) **defines** the cutting operation this fidelity presupposes. The question is what the cut does to its own conditions. When God names the whole in which the defining takes place, or Subject names the one for whom the distinction appears, treating the referent as one further bounded object changes its office. A more elaborate object-description repeats that change. Adding the sentence “this description is incomplete” does not repair it if the account continues to operate as though its source were contained.

The definition must therefore make its own implication consequential: this is the account, this is the act of accounting, and the latter has not disappeared into the former. It does not need an impossible inventory of every condition. It needs to preserve the determining relation through the determination it makes.

## #2

Draft 3 gives this pressure a bodily exactness: **“a fish trying to describe water while swimming in it.”** The sentence about the whole is another event within the whole. Its inability to occupy an exterior is not a missing observation that one more sentence would supply. [A03 — Immutable Gap / Formal Limit](../A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) **qualifies** every attempt to treat such additional representation as a final capture of the representing condition.

Taylor's [Draft 3 source house](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md#taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3-q005) **sources** this image and the constitutive failure of the definition; its direct carrier is “The Definition,” line 139. Here failure has a specified object: the attempt to exhaust or possess the source in a predicate. [C04 — Formal Limit](C04-Formal-Limit.md) **qualifies** the distinction between this reproduced limit and a remediable absence of information.

## #3

A faithful definition does more than report its limit. It reaches the limit through its own claim and allows that encounter to change how the claim is held. Draft 3's definition succeeds through the failure of final predication because the defining act becomes visible within what the definition means. Its image is **“a cage where a window was needed”**: the fault is the image's claim to totality, not the fact that an image has been made.

[C21 — Living Symbol / Idol](C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) **defines** this difference between determinate disclosure and occupation of the source-office. The window has a particular frame; fidelity does not require removing the frame. It requires the account to let through what it frames, including what changes the terms under which it was first approached.

The self-opening thought is therefore not a weak definition. Draft 3 calls it **“a determinate proposition built to carry its own negation as cargo.”** Its account of [open conceptuality](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md#taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3-q022) **sources** that formulation at line 255. The negation carried here concerns the proposition's pretension to finality. The account remains responsible for what it asserts while relinquishing the claim that assertion possesses its condition.

## #4

This responsibility gives fidelity a practical test. The account must let another reader recover what it determines, how it arrived there and what would require a correction. An erroneous distinction requires revision; a disputed historical attribution requires its textual warrant; a finite model's success requires its domain to remain explicit. None of those obligations is discharged by invoking an ungraspable whole. Equally, no gap in historical evidence by itself refutes the authorial operation of including the defining act.

The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** this relation: account answers to source without replacing source. This is evidence register 3, an operational relation, not a claim of common word ancestry. Fidelity holds two commitments together: the whole exceeds the frame, and this particular frame is where the encounter is taking place. Neglect of the first turns the account into an idol; neglect of the second evades the work of saying anything answerable.

[A23 — Trust, Faith and the Formal Limit](../A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **extends** the definition into commitment through time. [C48 — Trust / Faith under Formal Limit](C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) **tests** whether reliance remains open to consequence and correction. Naming a limit is not yet risking a relation; fidelity requires that what returns can matter to the account and to the one who gives it.

## #5→0

Even an account that describes the entire movement remains an account. Draft 3 makes the next turn explicit: the fourth position still speaks *about* God; first-person recognition changes the register. The one attempting the definition recognises its own implication in what was being defined. C02 preserves the consequence for every later use of faithful definition: describing answerability cannot substitute for becoming answerable.

[A18 — Primordial Symbolon and Its Eight Determinations](../A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** this return in the whole native field. The defining movement belongs within relation, ground/mark, question/assertion, polarity, indefinite particular, AM/IS, the infinite/finite articulation and inverse return; these are distinct determinations, not six interchangeable names for epistemic caution. [A36 — Advent of Integral Zero](../A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) **extends** the performed fidelity into the essay's final return, where the achieved sign bears its source-relation without losing its determinate operation.

This page **returns-to** [A01](../A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md): the definition must do what it says. Its achieved form becomes available for use, encounter and correction. The window remains a window when the light arriving through it is allowed to alter the account.

**Depth Restoration:** restored for C02's distinct operation: positive accountable determination, inclusion of the defining act, constitutive non-exhaustion versus correctable error, the window/cage and self-opening-thought formulations, and performative return. A01 retains the complete Subject/God performance; C02 does not duplicate that proof.

**Unresolved Delta:** historical theories of definition and the tradition-specific śuddhavikalpa comparison still require their own exact textual carriers before historical exposition here. Draft 3 supplies authorial language, not independent warrant for its external comparisons. The present claim is **Argued** from that authorial development; the quoted images are internal provenance, and no historical, mathematical or theological attribution is promoted by their restoration.
